type Result = { kind: "ok"; value: number } | { kind: "error"; message: string }; function read(r: Result): string { if (r.kind !== "ok") { return r.message; } else { return "ready"; } } let output: string = read({ kind: "error", message: "bad" });
type Result = { kind: "ok"; value: number } | { kind: "error"; message: string }; function read(r: Result): string { if ("error" === r.kind) { return r.message; } else { return "ready"; } }

type Tri = { kind: "left"; left: number } | { kind: "right"; right: number } | { kind: "idle"; other: number }; function read(r: Tri): number { if (r.kind === "left") { return r.left; } else if (r.kind === "right") { return r.right; } else { return r.other; } }
type Pair = { code: 1; first: number } | { code: 2; second: number }; function pick(p: Pair): number { if (p.code === 1) { return p.first; } else { return p.second; } }
type Flag = { ok: true; value: number } | { ok: false; reason: string }; function read(f: Flag): number { if (f.ok === true) { return f.value; } else { return 0; } }

type Result = { kind: "ok"; value: number } | { kind: "error"; message: string }; function read(r: Result): number { if (r.kind === "ok") { if (r.value > 0) { return r.value; } else { return 0; } } else { return 0; } }

type Result = { kind: "ok"; value: number } | { kind: "error"; message: string }; function sum(xs: Result[]): number { let total: number = 0; for (const r of xs) { if (r.kind === "ok") { total = total + r.value; } } return total; } let data: Result[] = [{ kind: "ok", value: 21 }, { kind: "error", message: "bad" }]; let output: number = sum(data);
